utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Madam Registrar, could you call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. Good morning, Your Honours. This is case number IT-99-36-T, the Prosecutor versus Radoslav Brdjanin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Brdjanin, can you hear me in a language that you can understand?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honour. Yes, I can hear you and understand you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. You may sit down. Appearances for the Prosecution?

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Joanna Korner assisted by Denise Gustin, case manager.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Good morning to you. Appearances for Radoslav Brdjanin?

utterances.speaker: MR. ACKERMAN
utterances.text: Good morning Your Honours, I'm John Ackerman with David Cunningham and Vesna Anic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you and good morning to you. I was told and I can feel it actually, that the temperature inside the courtroom is not exactly as it should be. If it becomes an inconvenience, let -- yes, Ms. Korner?

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: [Microphone not activated] I was just standing because I thought Your Honour was addressing me.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: If it becomes an inconvenience, do let me know and I have already seen arrangements could be made then to shift to Courtroom II, where presumably it will be a little bit cooler but it seems that the problem that there was with the air-conditioning is solved because I can feel the cool air coming in but if it becomes either too cold or too warm, let me know. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: While I'm on my feet, may I take the opportunity just to ask Your Honours again I know that we are pestering slightly about this, when we can expect the decision.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Yes. I say Your Honour said that last week.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Exactly. Last week I said it will be next week, which is this week. So now, any other preliminaries before we bring in the witness? We are in closed session now, all right? We go into closed session. And Madam Usher can bring in the witness, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: 1.42 p.m., to be reconvened on Friday, the 6th day of June, 2003, at 9.00 a.m. 22 23 24 25
